entries.0249eb93f6b74425: It provides print solutions for high-volume production of a small variety of products, using offset printing, silk-screen printing, on-demand printing and similar methods. It also uses its network of partner companies to handle short-lead-time production.
entries.0717af939e056316: It produces sales promotion advertising materials using augmented reality (AR) technology. It provides “Promotion AR,” used for attracting visitors to tourist facilities and similar measures, and “Novelty AR,” for novelty goods.
entries.0a389d7777fa4254: As a comprehensive sales promotion support company with production capabilities, this single-segment business centers on inkjet printing and produces sales promotion advertising materials and similar items. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥4,495 million. Production bases are located in Osaka, Yokohama, Nagoya and Fukuoka, and production is carried out on a 24-hour basis at the main bases. Consolidated subsidiary Idei Co., Ltd. plans, designs and produces printed materials and advertisements as an advertising agency.
entries.0cdac051cb05411b: It sells digital signage equipment and video distribution systems. It also works to expand domestic sales of its partner’s AI-equipped monitors, supporting the DX of store sales promotion activities.
entries.163629dc2e333972: This is the main service, producing sales promotion POP and fixtures, outdoor advertising signs used in stores, commercial facilities and exhibitions, interior products such as wallpaper and flooring, fabric print products, and exterior curtains for print-sticker machines. Because no printing plates are made, it can handle short lead times and very small lots, and can print on materials other than paper. It owns more than 100 commercial inkjet printers and processing machines in urban centers nationwide.
entries.2a282f37666dc840: A comprehensive sales promotion support company, centered on inkjet printing, that handles everything from producing advertising materials for sales promotion to advertising agency work.

entries.c3e6a08084d1be37: A business run by consolidated subsidiary Idei Co., Ltd., which acts as an advertising agency producing printed materials and carrying out advertisement planning, design and production.
